summary.text: Jerald Raymond is a Republican who represents District 31 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term; the directory lists Raymond's occupation as rancher and livestock consultant.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Raymond was born in Rigby, raised in Menan, graduated from Rigby High School and attended Ricks College.
It lists Raymond as a past president of the Idaho Cattle Association and a former Jefferson County commissioner.
